title: Locker Room Attack!!!
flavorText: Rey Jaguar was attacked in the Locker Room before his match, but that's not stopping him from going out there and winning anyways!!!
objective: Win a Game as Rey Jaguar.
setupInstructions: Base game only, standard setup. Play as Rey Jaguar.

title: Broken Neck, Unbreakable Will
flavorText: Kurt Angle competed at the Olympics with a legit broken neck. Somehow, some way, he's still walking away with the gold!!! Can you?
objective: Win a Game as Kurt Angle.
setupInstructions: Play solo on Standard difficulty, OR as a 2-player singles match. Kurt starts the match with HALF his Starting Health & Stamina — 8 Health and 8 Stamina.
modifiers: Whenever Angle would take damage, his player may discard a card from the top of the deck for every damage dealt instead, representing him 'gutting it out' through the pain. For example: if Kurt would take 3 damage, he may discard 3 cards from the top of his deck instead.
IMPORTANT: If the Anklelock would be discarded this way, draw it into your hand instead.
notes: Do not forget the Referee Stoppage Rules (P15 of the ATW Base Manual).

title: All Time King!!!
flavorText: The Deathmatch King Matt Cardona has something to prove. That he is the King no matter what era! Where better to prove it than at ATW!!! How better than in a Barbwire Exploding Death Match!!! What better way to crown himself THE UNDISPUTED DEATHMATCH KING OF ALLLLLL TIIIIIME????? Ladies and Gentlemen... I present you Matt Cardona vs Sabu, Raven and RVD in a Barbwire Exploding.... GAUNTLET DEATHMATCH!!!!!
objective: Defeat Sabu, Raven, and RVD as Matt Cardona. No pinfalls — wrestlers are defeated when their Health reaches 1.
setupInstructions: Play solo on Medium difficulty, OR as a 2-player game (one player as Cardona, the other controlling Sabu, Raven, and RVD). Set up the Barbwire Exploding Death Match as normal. Set up Sabu, Raven, and RVD's player boards, and randomly select one of the three to face Cardona first.
conditions: Wrestlers are defeated when their Health reaches 1.
modifiers: The first match proceeds and concludes as normal. If Matt Cardona wins, randomly select the next wrestler from those remaining and reset the timer for the exploding death match.

Before each new match: Matt Cardona gains +5 Health and +7 Stamina (up to his max). Reset his deck and randomly discard 2 cards — his Finisher cannot be discarded this way; return it to the deck if drawn.
Repeat this process before the third and final match as well.

title: Timber!!!
flavorText: Macho Man Randy Savage has a score to settle with the biggest man in the business. How would one put The Eighth Wonder of the World away for good? Send him crashing through a table of course!!! OHHHH YEAAAAH!!!
objective: As Randy Savage, put André the Giant through a Table to win the match.
setupInstructions:
All Or Nothing, Last Man Standing Setup (With modifiers - explained in the modifier section of this challenge).
(Check Double Trouble Rule Book for Last Man Standing Setup).
For the Weapon display place a table in the left most slot of the display. This is never removed. Shift it down when it is setup, and when it is used move it back up to the same slot of the display.
Randy Savage & André the Giant Player boards and decks.
Play it solo on Hard difficulty (Advanced 1v1 Solo Rules)
OR
Play it as a 2 Player game: (one player as Randy Savage, the other as André the Giant)
conditions: Must win specifically by putting your opponent through a table. Execute a Devastating Attack using a “Signature” Move or “Finisher” ONLY WITH A TABLE.
modifiers: A table will always be available in the leftmost slot of the weapon display. If the weapons in the display are refreshed, the table in that slot remains.
André the Giant starts with 2 reversal cubes available.

Putting a wrestler through a table normally ends things immediately, but this is André The Giant... It’s not that easy! The first time André would be put through a table, he does a reversal. Use a cube if available and if there are no cubes available he does this reversal for free. This reversal is unavoidable. He can only be put through a table the second time it happens.
The Kick-out rule from the Last Man Standing game-mode does not apply for this match.

title: Lie, Cheat & Steal
flavorText: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! It’s time for the ATW Weekly Main Event! This week's challenge is “Lie, Cheat & Steal”. When you're Eddie Guerrero, winning isn't everything... it's HOW you win. The referee has his hands full tonight because Latino Heat is ready to use every trick in the book. Can you lie, cheat and steal your way to victory?
objective: Win a match as Eddie Guerrero.
setupInstructions: Use the Eddie Guerrero Expansion with any compatible ATW game. Play solo on Medium difficulty (or Hard for some extra heat), OR play as a 2-player game in a Singles Match.
conditions: Before Eddie is allowed to win the match, he must successfully complete all three modifiers.
modifiers: Successfully perform 3 Taunts.
Successfully perform 2 Signature Moves.
Successfully use one of Eddie's Scheme Cards.
notes: Use spare dice or pen and paper to track completed objectives. Once all three objectives are complete, Eddie may finish the match normally.

title: Who Needs Friends?!
flavorText: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! It's time for the ATW Weekly Main Event! This week's challenge is “WHO NEEDS FRIENDS?!”. Tag Team wrestling is all about teamwork. Trust. Communication. Helping your partner when they need you most. Yeah... Forget ALL of that. Your team absolutely HATES each other.
objective: Both wrestlers must enter the match at least once AND each wrestler must successfully perform a [[signature]]/[[finisher]] before your team is allowed to win.
setupInstructions:
ATW All or Nothing / Double Trouble Tag Team setup.
Choose ANY TWO compatible ATW wrestlers to form your team.
Choose another two wrestlers as your opponents.
Play it solo on Medium difficulty (or Hard for some extra heat)
OR
Play it as a 2 Player game - Tag Match (Both Players can play with the Modifiers).
conditions: Both wrestlers must enter the match at least once.
Each wrestler must successfully perform a [[signature]]/[[finisher]] before your team is allowed to win.
modifiers: I Don't Need Your Help: No [[tag]]ging until the active wrestler reaches half Starting Health (Blind Tag modifier overrides this).
You Stole My Spotlight: Whenever the active wrestler Taunts, their partner loses 2 [[stamina]].
Blind Tag: The first time either wrestler successfully performs a [[signature]] Move, their partner immediately tags themselves in.
Fine! Do It Yourself: The first time a wrestler reaches 1/4 Starting Health, their partner refuses to [[tag]] in until the active wrestler successfully lands an attack.
Not My Problem: No interrupting [[pin]]falls until the very last kickout attempt.
notes: Post a picture of your match and, most importantly, tell us which crazy ATW pairing you created!

title: Deadly Combat — Year One
flavorText: The Siberian prison yard goes silent as the guards escort the newest inmate into the pit. They call him OMZ — the Knockout Artist. Five tournaments. Five years. Freedom on the line. This is where it all began: Deadly Combat, the covert tournament where the world's most notorious criminals and fighters settle their scores. Your first opponent stands between you and a legend's birth.
objective: Win a Submission match as OMZ against Gilgamesh.
setupInstructions: Base game only, standard setup. Play as OMZ. Play solo on Medium difficulty, OR as a 2-player singles match (one player as OMZ, the other as Gilgamesh).
conditions: You must win by making Gilgamesh submit — a pinfall victory does not count.
modifiers: The Knockout Artist's debut: whenever OMZ successfully performs a Strike, Gilgamesh loses 1 extra [[stamina]] as the inmate fight-crowd roars him on.
Gilgamesh has nothing to lose: the first time he would reach 0 [[momentum]], he instead keeps 1 [[momentum]].
notes: Deadly Combat Year 1 of 5. Complete all five years to retrace OMZ's road from the pit to the promised land.

title: Deadly Combat — Year Two
flavorText: Word of the Knockout Artist spread through the cell blocks. Year two of Deadly Combat brought bigger monsters, bolder bruisers, and a rule the guards loved: no referee to stop anything. OMZ's hands were registered weapons; tonight they're just evidence. The Monster of the Midway, Kamala, waits in the pit.
objective: Win a No DQ match as OMZ against Kamala.
setupInstructions: Requires the ATW Rumble expansion for Kamala. Play as OMZ. Play solo on Medium difficulty (or Hard for some extra pain), OR as a 2-player No DQ match (one player as OMZ, the other as Kamala).
conditions: There are no disqualifications and no count-outs. Survive and win.
modifiers: Pit rules: whenever Kamala would Taunt, he instead deals 1 damage to OMZ — the Ugandan Headhunter hunts by instinct, not showmanship.
Body Shots pay off: OMZ's own ability already chips Kamala's [[stamina]] on Kick and Knee attacks; in the pit that grinding style is how champions are made.
notes: Deadly Combat Year 2 of 5. The Rumble expansion brings the Monster of the Midway to the pit.

title: Deadly Combat — Year Three
flavorText: Three years in. Three tournaments survived. By now the prison yard knew the ritual: every summer the guards cleared the block, the ladder went up against the cell wall, and the briefcase at the top went to whoever could climb through the carnage. A three-time champion doesn't get a soft draw — he gets the Loose Cannon, Brian Pillman, and a ladder.
objective: Win a Ladder match as OMZ against Brian Pillman.
setupInstructions: Requires the ATW Trailblazers expansion for Brian Pillman. Play as OMZ. Play solo on Hard difficulty, OR as a 2-player Ladder match (one player as OMZ, the other as Brian Pillman).
conditions: Climb the ladder and grab the prize to win. Pillman will do everything legal — and illegal — to stop you.
modifiers: The Loose Cannon refuses to lose alone: whenever Brian Pillman would be defeated this turn, he may immediately make one free attack against OMZ before falling.
Climbing under fire: while OMZ is on the ladder he cannot block; Pillman's first attack against a climbing OMZ each turn deals +1 damage.
notes: Deadly Combat Year 3 of 5. Trailblazers brings the Loose Cannon to the cell block.

title: Deadly Combat — Year Four
flavorText: Four tournaments. Four trophies. Four years of men carried out of the pit on stretchers while OMZ walked out under his own power. The guards stopped betting against him; they started betting on how long the newcomers lasted. Year four's draw was the cruelest yet: Daemon, the Extreme expansion's own piece of the darkness, in a match where the only way down is the ten count — or never.
objective: Win a Last Man Standing match as OMZ against Daemon.
setupInstructions: Requires the ATW Extreme expansion for Daemon. Play as OMZ. Use the Last Man Standing setup (see the Double Trouble rule book). Play solo on Hard difficulty, OR as a 2-player Last Man Standing match (one player as OMZ, the other as Daemon).
conditions: Daemon must fail his own ten count to lose. Pinfalls don't end this — only standing does.
modifiers: The darkness answers: the first time each turn that Daemon reaches 0 or fewer [[health]], roll the die; on an odd result he rises at 1 [[health]] instead of falling — once per turn.
No mercy in the pit: the Kick-out rule from the Last Man Standing game-mode does not apply for this match.
notes: Deadly Combat Year 4 of 5. Extreme brings the darkness to the pit. One year remains.

title: Deadly Combat — Year Five: The Gauntlet
flavorText: Freedom. One more tournament and the gates open for the first time in five years. But the warden has seen enough of the Knockout Artist to rig the final draw: not one champion — three. Every man OMZ ever beat, returned and hungry, one after another, no rest, no mercy. Gauntlet rules. Win them all, and walk out of Siberia a free man. This is the year that made the legend.
objective: Defeat Gilgamesh, Kamala, and Daemon in Gauntlet order as OMZ — three wins, one breath.
setupInstructions: Requires the ATW Extreme and ATW Rumble expansions. Play as OMZ. Play solo on Legendary difficulty, OR as a 2-player gauntlet (one player as OMZ, the other controlling all three opponents). Randomly select the first opponent; the remaining two follow in drawn order.
conditions: No pinfalls — gauntlet opponents are defeated when their Health reaches 1.
If OMZ falls at any point, the gauntlet restarts from the first remaining opponent.
modifiers: Between matches: OMZ recovers +5 Health and +5 Stamina (up to his max), resets his deck, and randomly discards 2 cards — his Finisher cannot be discarded this way; return it to the deck if drawn.

The returning champions remember: each defeated opponent's player chooses one of their abilities to haunt the next gauntlet match — the next opponent gains that ability for the remainder of the gauntlet.
The fifth victory frees the man: when the last opponent's Health reaches 1, OMZ has won Deadly Combat five consecutive years and earns his freedom.
notes: Deadly Combat Year 5 of 5 — the finale. Beat the gauntlet and write the legend's last line.
